pillars.name: End-market demand growth
pillars.description: Customer demand remains strong enough to support the investment thesis
pillars.key_indicators: Unit growth, pricing, backlog, and management commentary
pillars.intact_signal: Demand indicators stable or improving across the covered companies
pillars.invalidation_signal: Demand weakens materially or customers cancel major projects

pillars.name: Major-customer budget trajectory
pillars.description: MajorCustomerA/MajorCustomerB continue funding projects tied to the thesis
pillars.key_indicators: Budget guidance, project commitments, and customer order backlog
pillars.intact_signal: Budgets guide up or remain stable, with no broad project cancellations
pillars.invalidation_signal: Multiple major customers cut relevant budgets in the same quarter

pillars.name: EmergingCompetitor competitive threat contained
pillars.description: EmergingCompetitor remains behind SupplierA/SupplierB on capability and scale
pillars.key_indicators: EmergingCompetitor node progress, yield rates, product mix, sanctions effectiveness
pillars.intact_signal: EmergingCompetitor remains at least one generation behind on key capabilities
pillars.invalidation_signal: EmergingCompetitor reaches parity or captures meaningful share

pillars.name: Supply discipline
pillars.description: Industry supply growth stays aligned with demand instead of moving into oversupply
pillars.key_indicators: Inventory days, lead times, capacity additions, and pricing discipline
pillars.intact_signal: Inventories remain controlled and pricing does not deteriorate sharply
pillars.invalidation_signal: Supply additions outpace demand and inventory builds across the sector

pillars.name: Revenue materialization
pillars.description: The tracked theme converts into reported revenue instead of remaining narrative-only
pillars.key_indicators: Segment revenue, customer adoption, bookings, and conversion from backlog
pillars.intact_signal: Theme-linked revenue grows and management can identify durable customer demand
pillars.invalidation_signal: Revenue growth stalls despite continued headline interest
